revisionPolicy: Version derives from the normalized resource file inventory; the archive hash identifies the imported input, not an independently audited origin.
platformScope: UTF-8 skill resources can be unpacked on win32, darwin and linux; referenced tools and optional scripts retain independent platform requirements.

license.declared: Not established for imported skill content
license.scope: The repository MIT license applies to Harness source code only and does not grant rights to imported skill files.
license.thirdPartyReview: Authorship, upstream revisions, and reuse or redistribution permissions have not been independently verified per skill.

eni-reverse-skill.note: KB router layer (kb/, templates, skills/mcp) not present in the archive import.

audit.excludedReason: The request was to expand skill resources; archive installers and host-level behavior patches are not skill resources and are not loaded or executed.

audit.pathPolicy: Shipped provenance never contains build-machine absolute paths; origins are logical names and the archive is identified by archiveSha256 and archivePath inside the zip.
audit.bootstrapStatus: Imported skill files are data; referenced bootstrap helpers and external tools are not installed by this package.
audit.executionPolicy: Packaging and resource installation read files only; no script execution, network fetch, external Agent setup, or credential configuration.
audit.textPolicy: Normalize CRLF to LF; preserve UTF-8 content otherwise. User-level instruction files and non-skill plugins are excluded.
